d: The board of NVIDIA voted to reinstate their former CEO Jensen Huang, Trump called the board personally to harangue them, the stock shot up 30% today, Melania’s new series dropped on Amazon Prime this weekend, Trump gave a doozy of a press conference starting with an explanation of why he went out of his way to call Vladmir Putin his friend, he took some time to praise his new Chief of Staff Stephen Miller, and another briefing from Trump’s new White House Press Secretary!
